summary: The legal array length is capped at 50 elements, which is too small for an honest runtime-scaling verdict; the accepted implementation sorts one bounded array and scans half of it.

workload_bound.source_constraint: 2 <= n == nums.length <= 50, and n is even

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted implementation sorts at most 50 values once and then examines exactly n / 2 symmetric pairs, establishing O(n log n) time over the complete legal workload bound.

The certificate regression checks all 16,275 arrays over values 1 through 5 at even lengths 2, 4, and 6, then checks 1,000 deterministic legal arrays spanning every even length through the maximum of 50 against a direct removal oracle.
